title: Huldah Speaks for God
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler of big questions, and tonight King Josiah sends his big question to Huldah: Wren asks her teacher whether God is caring for her sick grandpa, and hears a brave, true answer.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Wren loves big questions, and tonight a king has a big question too. In Wren’s world today: Wren’s grandpa is in the hospital, and Wren wonders if God is still taking care of him. She carries the question all week. On Sunday she asks her teacher, Miss Ruth, who always tells the truth. Miss Ruth kneels down and says, “I don’t know everything. But I know God loves your grandpa, and He hears you.” Then they say a prayer together. Just like Josiah’s helpers who asked Huldah, Wren learned that God can send His answer through a person who listens to Him.
